n: Python Turtle lesson plan (Digital Technologies Hub)
t: A free 20-hour Year 7-8 course plan for drawing shapes with Python turtle.
steps: Find the DT Challenge Year 7/8 Python Turtle plan on the Digital Technologies Hub and download the PDF.
Read the plan, which is dated 2018.
Decide whether to use the linked Grok Learning course or a Python setup with turtle.
Ask IT to check the Grok Learning terms before students sign up.
Set up Python with turtle on a test computer.
Try the first move and turn commands yourself.
Plan the 20 hours across several weeks.
